## Background

The Reference Architecture workstream uses "primitives" and "patterns" with specific meaning: primitives are combined into patterns. The Critical Use Cases artifacts also use "pattern" (`Workflow Pattern`, `HITL Pattern`, and "workflow patterns" in prose), which conflicts with the RA usage and risks readers conflating the two.

## Proposed changes

- Rename the `Workflow Pattern` column and dimension to `Workflow Shape`
- Rename the `HITL Pattern` column and dimension to `HITL Shape`
- Remove other uses of "pattern" throughout the use case artifacts

## Files affected

- `use-case-inventory.md`: column headers, template, any references in Notes
- `schema-agentic-use-cases.md`: dimension names, definitions, summary table, open questions
- `README.md`: prose references to patterns
